packages.name: Source Agent
packages.description: A system-level agent that judges every origin's Sources against a fixed rubric.

packages.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo Agent
packages.description: Produces short-form reels from a single prompt through your own moneyprinterturbo-mcp server, and publishes them after human review.

packages.name: Strategy Agent
packages.description: A system-level agent that periodically reads how the Project's content performed and keeps a concise Strategic Memory of what it learned. It only reads OpenGroow's data and never creates a Mission, a Production Recipe or a Publication.
